target_buyer_1.organization: City of Ashtabula — City Manager's Office
target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: City Manager James Timonere has authority over Planning & Community Development which handles zoning permits. City of Ashtabula has budget authority for technology investments. The city contracts building permits to the county, creating a confusing two-step process that Permit Whisperer clarifies.

brandkit_for_mvp.positioning: The official AI-powered permit guidance tool for the City of Ashtabula — answering zoning and building permit questions for residents, contractors, and developers before they break ground.

typography_recommendation.body_font: Inter or Open Sans (clean sans-serif for readability)
typography_recommendation.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (for code references and permit numbers)

visual_direction.hero_image_concept: Aerial view of downtown Ashtabula with Lake Erie shoreline — showing the community that permitting helps build
visual_direction.color_scheme: Deep government navy blue with warm orange accents for CTA buttons and highlights
visual_direction.photography_style: Real Ashtabula locations, construction projects, community development imagery

design_tokens.button_style: solid navy with white text, orange for primary CTAs
design_tokens.form_style: clean bordered inputs with navy focus ring

implementation_recommendations.brand_alignment: Align with City of Ashtabula's municipal identity — professional, trustworthy, community-focused
key_features_needed: AI-powered 'Do I need a permit?' Q&A interface
Zoning vs Building permit distinction (two-step process clarification)
City of Ashtabula specific code references
Common permit types: fences, sheds, decks, additions, driveways, signs, food trucks

AI eliminates 10-15 hrs/week of repetitive phone inquiries
Already has 48-hour go-live promise and ROI data on page
County recently refreshed building software — timing is right
